title: Decryption fails if C# scripts present in project
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: v4.5.1.stable.mono.official.f62fdbde1

### System information

Windows 11 - Godot  v4.5.1.stable.mono - Compatibility - dedicated NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4070

### Issue description

Decryption of encrypted project fails if any node has C# script attached. Project starts fine, then godot logo is visible and game crashes.

If I export with debug the game doesn't even launch but complains that package is missing. I managed to export with debug first to get the console.exe and then exported without debug to get the game to launch and then executing the console.exe version briefly gives this error:

```
ERROR: No loader found for resource: res://Main.cs (expected type: Script)
   at: (core\io\resource_loader.cpp:358)
ERROR: Can't load dependency: 'res://Main.cs'.
   at: (core\io\resource_format_binary.cpp:459)
ERROR: Error when trying to parse Variant.
   at: (core\io\resource_format_binary.cpp:503)
ERROR: Error when trying to parse Variant.
   at: (core\io\resource_format_binary.cpp:490)
ERROR: Failed loading resource: res://.godot/exported/133200997/export-3070c538c03ee49b7677ff960a3f5195-main.scn.
   at: (core\io\resource_loader.cpp:343)
ERROR: Failed loading scene: res//main.tscn.
   at: (main\main.cpp:4560)
```

### Steps to reproduce

1. Create new project
2. Attach C# script to any node in the scene
3. Export to Windows using custom export template with encryption enabled
4. Try to run the game executable

In the minimal reproduction project you can test this by first exporting with custom export template without any C# scripts attached and running the executable. Everything should work fine.

Then go ahead and attach the Main.cs script to any node in the scene and do the export again. Now it will no longer decrypt/launch.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[demo-mono-encryption.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/23560116/demo-mono-encryption.zip)
